verify.errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
verify.errors.invalid_details: We could not verify those details. Please check your name and number and try again.
verify.errors.phone_format: Please enter a valid Sri Lankan telephone number.
verify.errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
verify.errors.expired: This code has expired. Please ask for a new one.
verify.errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Please try again later.
verify.errors.cooldown: Please wait {seconds} seconds before asking for a new code.
verify.errors.unavailable: Verification is not available right now. Please try again later.
verify.errors.network: Network problem. Please check your connection and try again.
verify.success.greeting: Welcome back, {name}! You are now verified, so you can ask me about your account.
access.customer_service_blocked: Help with accounts, bills, connections, faults, packages and usage is only available through SLT's dialing services. Please call {hotline} (toll free from SLT lines), send an SMS to {sms}, or for prepaid dial {prepaid}. You can also verify as an existing user to get full access.
llm.safety_blocked: I am sorry, I cannot help with that request. Please ask me something else about SLT-MOBITEL.
otp.sms_body: SLT-MOBITEL: Your verification code is {code}. It is valid for {minutes} minutes. Do not share it with anyone.
otp.email_body:
Hello,

Your SLT-MOBITEL verification code is {code}. It is valid for {minutes} minutes.

Do not share this code with anyone. SLT-MOBITEL will never ask you for it.

If you did not ask for this code, you can ignore this email.
customer.reauth_needed: To show your account details I need you to verify again. Please verify with a one time code and then ask me again.
customer.unavailable: I cannot reach your account details right now. Please try again later, or contact SLT directly: call {hotline} (toll free from SLT lines), send an SMS to {sms}, or call {prepaid} for prepaid.
customer.changes_not_supported: I can only show account information here, I cannot make changes. To buy, activate, change or cancel anything, please call {hotline} (toll free from SLT lines), send an SMS to {sms}, or call {prepaid} for prepaid.
